name: amane
description: Amane - bounded financial authority for agents across EVM and Sui (testnet prototype, not audited)

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test --workspaces && npm run test:evm && npm run test:sui
scripts.vectors: npm run vectors -w @amane/core && cd packages/core && npx tsx scripts/generate-sui-scenarios.ts && npx tsx scripts/generate-codes.ts
scripts.build: npm run build -w @amane/core && npm run build -w @amane/sdk && npm run build -w @amane/policy && npm run build -w @amane/arc && npm run build -w @amane/cctp && npm run build -w @amane/verify
